Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/capability_selection.py

src/agent_runtime/capability_selection.py

Python · Tier A

Freeze routing settings and a compact, digested tool ceiling at acceptance, then project model- selected Skills within it. Resume restores server-owned snapshots and explicit core-tool migrations; it does not rerun selection or import new defaults. Availability, permissions, credentials and task-resource grants remain separate owners. Functions mutate accepted/resume state only where documented and perform no network probing.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
CapabilitySelectionConfig 51 Validated per-scope routing preferences: Automatic by default, with explicit always-selected Skills and tools bounded by schema limits. This selects within a separate accepted authority ceiling; it does not grant access or establish availability.
CapabilitySelectionConfig.version 62 Accept only the integer version 1 before Pydantic coercion, so booleans and numeric strings cannot masquerade as a supported configuration version.
CapabilitySelectionConfig.canonical 70 Sort and deduplicate the two Always lists in the validated model so equivalent configuration serializes consistently. Registry identity and ceiling checks occur in normalize_config.
CapabilitySelectionHint 79 Strict selector response containing only schema version and selected canonical Skill IDs. Registry membership and authority are checked during projection rather than trusted from model output.
CapabilitySelectionHint.version 88 Reject every version except the exact integer 1, reporting the selector-output diagnostic rather than silently coercing an unsupported response.
CapabilitySettings 94 One atomic scope edit, without changing AgentCapabilityPolicy v1.
normalize_config 105 Return canonical selection settings after validating known registry IDs and, when supplied, containment of every Always choice in the accepted ceiling. None uses product defaults; unknown or disallowed identities raise before selection is accepted.
automatic 126 Report whether the saved configuration explicitly requests Automatic mode. Missing configuration returns false so legacy state is not implicitly upgraded into a new selection request.
candidate_catalog 130 O(skills), not O(raw tool schemas); authority requires no live probes.
capability_manifest 140 Source metadata only: no schemas, instructions, configuration or probes.
accept_authority 156 Mutate accepted context with canonical routing settings, a compact catalog and a digested ceiling including source manifest and grant provenance. Reuse a supplied freshly compiled ceiling only without an upstream fence, restrict Advisory to internal tools, and preserve required tools. Existing snapshots are validated and receive only the explicit core-tool migrations; defaults are not recompiled on resume.
validate_authority 227 Check that all authority fields exist, selection settings validate, the ceiling digest matches its contents, and Always/catalog IDs stay within that ceiling. Raise for inconsistent snapshots; this is integrity validation of server-owned state, not authentication of arbitrary caller- supplied dictionaries.
hint_schema 244 Build the selector's strict response schema with candidate Skill IDs as the enum. For an empty catalog require an empty selection list; no provider probing or capability expansion occurs.
projection 260 Validate the model's selected Skills against the candidate catalog, add required and Always choices, then intersect tools and dependencies with the accepted ceiling. Return sorted exposure sets and Skills whose required dependencies are unavailable. An Always tool adds its owner's guidance without enabling sibling tools; permitted baseline file.read remains available independently.
union_hint 293 Internal union includes required/dependency-only owners, never asks to route them.
restore_context 306 Restore a saved authority envelope and accepted projection into resume context after integrity checks and supported core-tool migrations. Legacy runs without selection state remain Manual; an incomplete Automatic selection fails rather than selecting again. Automatic state awaiting its first selection exposes only required tools.
validate_selection 336 Reject incomplete or tampered accepted epochs rather than selecting again.
upgrade_kv 361 Validate a legacy saved envelope, then add only core KV ownership/tool identities and update the current epoch digest, policy allowance and saved resume context. This mutates the supplied state without inference or a new selection epoch; prior epoch records remain historical.
upgrade_task_context 427 Migrate a valid older envelope that lacks Task Context by adding its controller-local tools and updating current authority/selection digests. Preserve unrelated grants and routing choices, patch saved resume allowances, and return without changes when the Skill is already present.
